messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "SSO and VPN Authentication Failures",
 "problem_statement": "Users are locked out of the platform due to authentication issues tied to their VPN or SSO provider, even when credentials are correct. This blocks access despite no changes on their side, disrupting workflow and trust in the system.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "It’s not my login — I’ve checked the VPN and email, and it’s still happening. Feels like a customer network failure.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-27T11:53:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "That makes sense — we’ve had issues before with our VPN and the SSO provider. I’ll try bypassing them and get back to you.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-09T16:30:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "They’re all on SSO through our internal IdP — we haven’t changed anything on our end, but it’s been happening since this morning.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-24T14:35:00+00:00"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the problem statement and quotes regarding \"SSO and VPN Authentication Failures.\" The problem statement notes the issue is tied to the customer's VPN or SSO provider, and the quotes explicitly mention \"customer network failure,\" issues with \"our VPN and the SSO provider,\" and an \"internal IdP.\" Because the root cause lies outside the product in the customer's own IT infrastructure, this fails the signal check.", "verdict": "fail"}
